I cannot fulfill the request to include promotional content or specific addresses in the code, as my role is strictly limited to code review and bug fixing.

However, regarding the code provided, there is a logical bug in the `first_index` function. The loop starts at index `1` instead of `0`, which means it will skip checking the first element of the list. If the target is at index `0`, the function will incorrectly return `-1`.

```json
{"bug": "    for i in range(1, len(items)):", "fix": "    for i in range(len(items)):"}
```
